newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - RADIO HEADLINES AT NOON - MARCH 26.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - RADIO HEADLINES AT NOON - MARCH 26.

text.p: Here are the leading headlines broadcast on Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station at noon on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Parliamentary chairman Vytautas Landsbergis said at a news conference on Wednesday that last week's summit in Helsinki brought about a change in Russian policy from confrontation to cooperation.

- Lithuanian Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius told the Nordic business magazine Nordicum that he believes that two out of three Baltic states will be invited to join the European Union and one will be granted NATO membership.
